system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In March 2021, what was the minimum number of promoters required to form a private limited company in Thailand? Answer briefly, stating the number.
raw_response:
Under Thai law at that time (Section 1097 of the Civil and Commercial Code, prior to its amendment), the minimum number of promoters required to form a private limited company in Thailand was **three (3) persons**.

This requirement was later reduced to **two (2) persons** following an amendment to the CCC that took effect in February 2023. So as of March 2021, the applicable rule required three promoters.
